experiment_data.hypothesis: Qwen-14B KL 30% with seed 123 should replicate s42's MMLU reversal pattern (KL < TEAL on MMLU), confirming it is a systematic property of the loss function on this model family rather than seed-specific noise. Multi-seed replication strengthens W2 response about MMLU reversal being architecture-dependent.
